title: Type 511 Mortar Spraying Machine Printed Table
seoTitle: Type 511 Mortar Spraying Machine | Pinjin Xingtai Table
description: Type 511 is a Xingtai mortar spraying machine printed at 380 V, 7.5 kW, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 32/38 mm hose, particle ≤6 mm and 30 m / 15 m. It is not Type 311, not the double-cylinder plunger 4 m³/h / 8 MPa unit and not a trailer concrete pump. Quote only.

relatedPaths.label: Type 511 mortar spraying machine product page

answerBlock.what: Type 511 is a Xingtai mortar spraying machine listing 380 V, 7.5 kW, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, hose 32/38 mm, particle ≤6 mm and 30 m / 15 m, 1700 × 550 × 900 mm, 260 kg. It is not Type 311 (4 kW, 2 m³/h, ≤2 mm), not the double-cylinder plunger 4 m³/h / 8 MPa unit, not M9 plaster and not a trailer concrete pump. Quote only.
answerBlock.who: Contractors matching 3 m³/h, ≤6 mm particle and 380 V to a mortar spraying job whose hose stays inside 30 m / 15 m.
factors: Particle ≤6 mm on this printed row
Output 3 m³/h and pressure 3–5 MPa
Hose 32/38 mm and 30 m / 15 m
380 V for the listed 7.5 kW motor

faqs.question: Can Type 511 replace Type 311?
faqs.answer: No. Type 311 lists 220/380 V, 4 kW, 2 m³/h, 25 mm hose, particle ≤2 mm and 15 m / 5 m. Match the printed row; do not treat 311 and 511 as one machine.

faqs.question: Is Type 511 a trailer concrete pump?
faqs.answer: No. It is a 380 V mortar spraying machine. Trailer pumps sit on the electric, diesel and mixer-pump hubs.
